title: Searching with staged changes shows the generic 'Unsaved changes' dialog instead of the NM-2395 warning text
requirementSource: NM-2395 / NM-4025 §7.4: Search attempted with dirty page → display 'Searching will cause you to lose unsaved changes. Continue?'
stepsToReproduce: Select a row, enter a Rate, click Apply.
expectedBehavior: Dialog text: 'Searching will cause you to lose unsaved changes. Continue?'
actualBehavior: Shared dialog (data-testid=location-settings-modal-unsaved-changes): 'Unsaved changes — Are you sure you want to leave this view? Any unsaved changes will be lost.' with Stay / Discard. Behaviour is correct: Discard discards and searches (TC-052), Stay keeps the staged values (TC-053).
decisionNeeded: Product to choose: change the copy to the NM-2395 text, or accept the shared dialog and update the requirement (then update IST_MESSAGES and drop the test.fail marker).
